The angle at B is labeled x°, the angle at D is labeled x°, the angle at A is labeled (4x − 26)°, and the angle at C is labeled (2x + 18)°. Reasoning: The interior angles of a quadrilateral sum to 360°. Therefore, x + x + (4x − 26) + (2x + 18) = 360. Combining like terms gives 8x − 8 = 360, so 8x = 368 and x = 46. Since angle D is labeled x°, the measure of angle D is 46°.
